bio: Giulia Puteri was baptized Giulia Francesca on 12 March 1717 at San Mango D'Aquino, Catanzaro, Calabria, Italy, the daughter of Giuseppe Putero and Beatrice Manfrida. An elder sister, also named Giulia, had been baptized in 1710. She married Francesco Colosimo on 26 February 1740. She is John's 7th-great-grandmother.
